pokedexEntries.bk: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

pokedexEntries.wh: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

pokedexEntries.us: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies’ attacks.

pokedexEntries.um: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

pokedexEntries.sh: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.
